Hi Toby —

Thanks for the clear questions. I've outlined two viable structures below so you can pick what fits Acme's accounting needs; both are compatible with our SOW and SLA:

Option A — Signature + 12-month amortization (preferred)
- Platform fee: 50% invoiced at signature, 50% amortized monthly over 12 months (line-itemed as platform amortization).
- Implementation credit: one-time starter credit applied against the "implementation services" line on the first invoice (applies to professional services invoices only).
- Support: Bronze/Silver/Gold retainer tiers. If you pick Silver or Gold and commit to 12 months, we apply a 10% support credit against the first three months of the retainer.

Option B — Reduced upfront + 18-month amortization (finance-friendly)
- Platform fee: 30% at signature, remaining amortized over 18 months.
- Implementation credit: applied as a deduction on platform fee (if you prefer to keep PS separate).
- Support: same tiering; larger credits (up to 20%) require sales approval and a minimum 18-month commitment.

Notes / constraints:
- Any credit >15% requires Executive approvals and coordinated sign-off with Finance (standard for our larger concessions).
- We can export a detailed invoice schedule and labeled line items for your auditors (I attached a sample pricing workbook).

Next steps: I attached a pricing workbook and a draft SOW showing the line items. If Option A works, I can share a formal invoice schedule and an updated term sheet for your PO team.

Would you like me to route the 10% starter credit as a PS line-item or as a platform fee reduction? I can do whichever is cleaner for Acme's audit trail.
